title: /vision skill writes VISION.md to gate agent feature work
summary: Kun Chen's /vision agent skill inspects repo context, proposes borderline feature ideas, and drafts a VISION.md file used to triage requests and catch implementation drift as agents scale.
question_it_answers: How do I define a durable product vision file that agents can use to accept or reject features?

claims.text: The /vision skill proposes 8–12 borderline features then writes VISION.md.
claims.evidence: the skill currently looks at what's already been done in the project to build context, and would then propose 8-12 hypothetical borderline feature ideas
claims.subject: design-agent-skills

claims.text: VISION.md sits above plans and code review as the next influence layer for agents.
claims.evidence: our influence has to go one level up - we need to define the vision.
claims.subject: design-agent-skills
